title: Claude Code â€” Intelligence
description: Comprehensive developer intelligence: session health, cost analysis, token breakdown, and tool usage patterns.

list.name: plan_monthly_cost
list.label: Plan ($/mo)
list.description: Your Claude subscription tier. Controls plan cost used in ROI panel. Set CLAUDE_PLAN_TYPE env var in hooks to match.

list.name: billing_days
list.label: Billing Days in Range
list.description: Days in selected time range. Used to prorate plan cost. Default 30 = full month.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="lifecycle"} | json | hook_type="session-end" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Plan ROI
panels.description: API retail cost as a multiple of your prorated plan cost. 1.0 = break even. 3.5 = you got $3.50 of compute per $1 paid. Adjust Billing Days to match your time range.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Cache Efficiency
panels.description: % of context tokens served from cache. High is good â€” less quota burn.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_read_tokens [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_input_tokens [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component=~"tool|mcp-.*"} | json | hook_type="post-tool-use" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", level="ERROR"} | json | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap assistant_turns [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))

panels.title: API Cost Over Time
panels.description: Cost per interval by model. $100 dashed line = monthly Max 5x plan cost.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Token Usage by Type
panels.description: Cache reads dominate â€” that's your context window in action. Output includes thinking tokens.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_read_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_creation_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_input_tokens [$__interval]))

panels.title: Tool Calls by Tool
panels.description: Tool usage frequency over time. Stacked bars show relative contribution of each tool per interval.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component=~"tool|mcp-.*"} | json | hook_type="post-tool-use" | project=~"$project" [$__interval]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component=~"tool|mcp-.*"} | json | hook_type="post-tool-use" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))
sum by (model) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))
sum by (effort) (count_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__interval]))
sum by (project) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Cost by Effort Level
panels.description: Total API-equivalent cost aggregated by effort setting. Lower effort = faster/cheaper; higher effort = more thinking, more cost.

targets.expr: sum by (effort) (sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions by Type
panels.description: How sessions are started: startup (new), resume (continuation), compact (post-compaction restart).

targets.expr: sum by (session_type) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="lifecycle"} | json | hook_type="session-start" | project=~"$project" [$__range]))

panels.title: Session Breakdown
panels.description: All sessions in selected time range, sorted by API cost. tool_use_count and thinking columns show session characteristics.

targets.expr: {app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort"

panels.title: Burn Rate â€” $/hr & Tokens/min
panels.description: How fast you are consuming API-equivalent budget. Averages over the selected time window.

panels.title: Avg $/hour
panels.description: API-equivalent spending rate per hour averaged over selected range.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 3600

panels.title: Avg $/minute
panels.description: API-equivalent spending rate per minute averaged over selected range.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Output Tokens/min
panels.description: Average Claude output token generation rate per minute.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Total Tokens/min
panels.description: Input + output token consumption rate per minute.

targets.expr: sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_input_tokens [$__range])) * 60
sum(rate({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__range])) * 60

panels.title: Tool Performance â€” Duration & Cost Correlation
panels.description: How long each tool type takes. Correlates tool execution time with token cost per turn.

panels.title: Avg Duration by Tool (ms)
panels.description: Average wall-clock milliseconds per tool call, broken down by tool name. Slowest tools = biggest opportunity for parallelization.

targets.expr: avg by (tool_name) (avg_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Call Count by Tool
panels.description: Total number of calls per tool in the selected time range. High counts = frequently used tools.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))

panels.title: Tool Wall-Clock Time vs Token Cost per Turn
panels.description: Purple bars = total tool execution time per turn (ms). Teal line = API cost per turn (USD). Turns with high tool time but low cost = I/O bound. High cost but low tool time = LLM compute bound.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap tool_time_ms [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.title: Total Tool Overhead (This Range)
panels.description: Sum of all tool wall-clock time. Divide by total API cost to see what % of session time was in tool execution vs LLM compute.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Avg Tool Duration per Call
panels.description: Mean duration across all tool calls. Spikes indicate slow external services (MCP, file I/O, etc.).

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Total Tool Calls
panels.description: Total number of tool invocations in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="tool"} | json | __error__="" | hook_type="post-tool-use" | tool_name!="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" [$__range]))

panels.title: User Engagement â€” Think Time
panels.description: How long the user pauses to review Claude's output before sending the next prompt. Measured from last session-stop to next user-prompt-submit. Longer = more deliberate review.

panels.title: Avg Think Time
panels.description: Average pause between Claude completing a turn and the user sending the next prompt. Higher values suggest the user is spending more time reading/reviewing output.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="user"} | json hook_type, user_think_time_ms, project | __error__="" | hook_type="user-prompt-submit" | user_think_time_ms > 0 | project=~"$project" | unwrap user_think_time_ms [$__range])

panels.title: Median Think Time
panels.description: P50 pause duration. More robust than avg â€” not skewed by long overnight gaps.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {app="claude-dev-logging", component="user"} | json hook_type, user_think_time_ms, project | __error__="" | hook_type="user-prompt-submit" | user_think_time_ms > 0 | project=~"$project" | unwrap user_think_time_ms [$__range])

panels.title: Prompts Measured
panels.description: Number of user prompts where think time was captured (requires a prior completed Claude turn in the same session).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="user"} | json hook_type, user_think_time_ms, project | __error__="" | hook_type="user-prompt-submit" | user_think_time_ms > 0 | project=~"$project" [$__range]))

panels.title: Think Time Per Prompt Over Time
panels.description: Each data point = one user-prompt-submit event with a measured think time. Spikes indicate the user paused longer to review Claude's output before responding. A rising trend signals more deliberate, careful engagement.

targets.expr: max_over_time({app="claude-dev-logging", component="user"} | json hook_type, user_think_time_ms, project | __error__="" | hook_type="user-prompt-submit" | user_think_time_ms > 0 | project=~"$project" | unwrap user_think_time_ms [$__interval])

panels.title: Output Tokens per $1
panels.description: How many output tokens per dollar of API compute cost. Canonical ratio: sum(total_output_tokens) / sum(cost_usd). Higher = more efficient.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_output_tokens [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.title: Cache Efficiency
panels.description: Canonical: cache_read / (cache_read + cache_creation) * 100. Higher = better cache reuse, less generation cost.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_read_tokens [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({app="claude-token-metrics"} | json | __error__="" | model=~"$model" | project=~"$project" | effort=~"$effort" | unwrap total_cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))
